name: manual_432f53
claim: Never assume Python's ipaddress predicates (is_reserved, is_private, is_global) map cleanly onto security-policy intent -- verify each predicate directly on the interpreter in use before writing address-classification logic that gates network egress

decisions.notes: CPython 3.13's ipaddress.ip_address('::1').is_reserved is True, which silently rejected IPv6 loopback as a prohibited address in a dial-authorization gate -- a real functional bug that survived three review passes (author, CodeRabbit, an independent adversarial review) because everyone trusted the predicate name over checking its actual behavior.
